text:
Sam T: Quick sync  Horizon Labs wants a short-term hosted pricing exception for a proof-of-concept. They want a lower per-token price for the first 3 billing cycles to run scale tests. Any objections?
Evan P: ask and volume?
Sam T: proposal from the customer: $0.00055/token for months 1-3 (our listed hosted rate is $0.0009). Expected traffic ~12M tokens/month in month1 then ramp to 20M in month3. They want no min month1, $1.5k month2, $3k month3.
Rhea V: prioritise how this shows on the invoice. Finance prefers a promo credit vs a live price change. AE wants rate change because procurement reviews unit price.
Billing Bot: To proceed, submit exception payload: {"customer":"Horizon Labs","override_rate":"0.00055","period_months":"3","estimated_tokens":"42000000","mins":"0/1500/3000"} and attach SOW/PO.
Sam T: math check: delta per token = 0.00035 -> expected discount ~14.7k over 42M tokens.
Evan P: engineering ops: ok to support but require hard caps + monitoring. Recommend hard cap 22M tokens/month, soft alert at 15M. Also require AE to whitelist POC API keys and mark them as non-prod to avoid cache contamination and unexpected evictions.
Rhea V: finance: we accept the erosion but must track it as a temporary exception and tag to Horizon expansion opportunity. Need signed SOW that explicitly references the temporary unit price OR confirm promo-credit workflow with a ticket. Also require a 10% buffer in our estimates for audit.
Sam T: suggested guardrails: (1) hard cap 22M/month enforced by billing (2) soft alerts at 15M/month to #prod-usage-watch (3) AE to add API keys to non-prod flagging (4) exception auto-expires after 3 cycles and reverts to standard pricing.
Billing Bot: Note: promo-credit path will show standard unit price on invoice with separate credit line. Rate override shows discounted unit price. Finance to choose.
Deal Desk: Conditional approval: provide SOW/PO (signed) or internal promo-credit ticket, add the monitoring alerts and non-prod flag, and finance to log the exception code. Approved for 3 cycles only.
Sam T: I'll update the SOW to include the temporary unit price and the hard caps. Will loop @Evan P to add the alert and @Rhea V to confirm promo path if procurement refuses to show rate change.
Evan P: I'll file the infra ticket to add alerts and to block keys past hard cap; cc eng-oncall. ETA today.
Rhea V: I'll reserve a promo credit code as backup and record the expected $14.7k impact (plus 10% buffer) in the exception tracker.
Sam T: Great, will send SOW to procurement and ping Deal Desk when uploaded. Thanks all :pray:
Deal Desk: Please attach the signed SOW or internal promo ticket here once available. We'll mark approved in CLM after paperwork. :white_check_mark:
